lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light-colored vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with light-colored upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, dark silhouette with a distinct high-contrast outline is attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
